scope: Bounded common-device service collection, fixed vendor classification, safe inventory recommendations and source-specific chat guidance
changes: Query fixed IPP/IPPS and commissionable Matter service types within existing scan bounds.
Bind only a canonical Synology vendor classification to the exact raw DNS label tuple in the same packet; discard raw TXT fields, duplicate and malformed claims.
Preserve type-specific reviewed next steps in current-message chat sharing.
Keep network clues separate from native HA setup candidates, including identical display names; only an exact supported HA flow can create a setup proposal.

checks.independent_review: Raw DNS label-alias issue reproduced, fixed, regression-tested and reviewed again.

limitations: No live household network scan or physical printer/NAS/Matter pairing was performed.
No real cloud account, model, HAOS backup/restore, installed login-loop, public USB or ISO acceptance was performed in this slice.
No Dell deployment, release publication, remote PR merge or household configuration change was performed.
New multicast queries and vendor projection require the new Host collector; updating Controller alone does not extend an installed old collector.
Synology classification requires matching PTR and TXT within the same packet; separate packets or missing TXT remain unidentified.
The IPv4-only collector does not establish Matter/Thread IPv6 connectivity.
Network observations and CUPS queues are not counts of distinct physical devices, setup authority or physical-function verification.

backend.scope_note: 300 integrated cases after raw DNS identity correction, before final plain-language next-step text. Overlaps the later guidance run; counts must not be added.

guidance.scope_note: 146 affected inventory/chat cases after final next-step wording; tested file contents match the final source hashes. Overlaps backend.

browser.scope_note: 83 final compiled product cases covering source-specific guidance, conversation discovery, explicit network collection, inventory and device setup history. APIs/households/model replies are fixtures.

earlier_ui_fixture_run.scope_note: Four new persisted-chat cases initially seeded a legacy browser storage key. Fixture was corrected to the owner-scoped key; final integrated browser run passes. No authorization check was weakened.

counting_note: Runs overlap; do not sum them as distinct tests.
